title: Data Presentation: Grouped Data, Pie Charts and Stem-and-Leaf
seo_title: Data Presentation – JSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Present data in grouped frequency tables, pie charts and stem-and-leaf diagrams; read and interpret statistical diagrams. (summary of the NERDC JSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 3 maths worksheets on data presentation: grouped frequency tables, pie charts, stem-and-leaf diagrams and reading statistical diagrams. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A grouped frequency table puts data into classes such as 10–19, 20–29.
  • In a pie chart, the angle for each group = frequency ÷ total × 360°.
  • A stem-and-leaf diagram keeps the actual data: the stem is the tens digit and the leaf is the units digit.

Examples

Example

Stem 3 | leaves 2 5 8

32, 35, 38

Answer: three values in the 30s

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Forgetting the keyRead the key: 3 | 2 means 32.
Using class width as frequencyRead the frequency column.
Angles not adding to 360°Check the total.
